page.layout: One page of a manuscript, not printed. Ink stains and handwritten marks cover the page. Handwriting only, no printed text. Edge of the neighbouring page at the left.
page.notes: This scan shows a handwritten page, not a printed one. It carries ink stains, pen strokes, tally-like marks and a few handwritten words in the lower right and lower left (apparently "veni", "fini", "Creat", "omnium", "fieri", "filii", "mundus" and similar). Handwriting is outside the scope of this transcription and is left out. The left edge shows part of the facing page, also handwritten, and is not transcribed.
